name: email-spam-filter
description: ADVISORY LLM spam triage: classify an inbound email (spam/ham + confidence) and RECOMMEND deliver vs quarantine. Fail-safe + injection-resistant — delivery is recommended only for an explicit ham verdict with confidence >= 0.85; spam, low confidence, or out-of-range scores recommend quarantine. The verdict is advisory over attacker-controlled content, not an authenticated security gate.

steps.description: Fail-safe advisory routing: recommend DELIVER only for a high-confidence ham verdict; otherwise recommend QUARANTINE.
steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  (((.classify.confidence)) | if type=="number" then . else -1 end) as $conf |
  (((.classify.label) == "ham") and ($conf >= 0.85) and ($conf <= 1.0)) as $deliver |
  "## Spam-filter recommendation: " + (if $deliver then "DELIVER" else "QUARANTINE" end) + "\n" +
  "**From:** " + ((.sender // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Subject:** " + ((.subject // "(no subject)") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**LLM label:** " + ((.classify.label // "(none)") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**LLM confidence:** " + ($conf | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Reason:** " + ((.classify.reason // "?") | tostring) + "\n\n" +
  (if $deliver then "Recommend delivery (ham, confidence >= 0.85)." else "Recommend quarantine — spam, low confidence (< 0.85), or out-of-range score." end) + "\n\n" +
  "_ADVISORY: this is an LLM assessment of attacker-controlled content, not an authenticated security decision. Do not release an email on this verdict alone — combine it with trusted signals (SPF / DKIM / DMARC, sender reputation) before delivery._"
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{recommendation: .}'
